description: PLA store-level response-rate bucketing grain for a marketplace over a period: raw ad requests and non-zero responses at store_id x category (L1 > L2 > L3) x day-of-month x hour-of-day grain, filtered to a single page_type (default 'category'). Returns only raw aggregates; the Python layer buckets each store-hour into zero/partial/full response and computes overall and eligibility-adjusted RR. Day-of-month and hour-of-day are derived via EXTRACT from the r.date_hour column.

store_id.description: The store the ad request was attributed to (PLA store_id).

category.description: Category hierarchy path (L1 > L2 > L3) the requests/responses were attributed to; 'na' where a level is missing.

day.description: Day-of-month (1-31) derived via EXTRACT(DAY FROM r.date_hour); used with hour to form the store-hour bucketing grain.

hour.description: Hour-of-day (0-23) derived via EXTRACT(HOUR FROM r.date_hour); used with day to form the store-hour bucketing grain.

page_type.description: The surface the ad served on (SEARCH, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, ...). Filter to a single value (default 'category') so requests/responses are not aggregated across page types within a store-hour.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Ad requests received for this store x category x day x hour grouping.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.non_zero_responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Requests that returned at least one ad (non-zero responses) for this store x category x day x hour grouping.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_product_ads_filtered_level_report` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
